company.name: Teleport
company.shortDescription: Teleport builds software to move individuals to the best place to live and work.
company.description:
Teleport builds software to move individuals to the best place to live and work. It enables users to explore the best cities based on their personal preferences, and lend them a hand with preparing and executing the move.

The company aims to make physically rearranging the human population just as easy.
